style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 60cm Pre Lit Red Beribboned Christmas Outdoor Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: Bring the spirit of the season into your home with ease. The 60cm Pre Lit Red Beribboned Christmas Outdoor Wreath keeps you in touch with the outside world. Set it on your front door to refresh your entrance with the pre lit Christmas wreath. The 3 red ribbons dotted about the faux foliage add a cosy note to the display. Make home feel like a breath of fresh air after the cold of the outdoors. Keep the light glowing, with the optional 6-hour timer, which can be programmed to illuminate the LEDs every evening at the same time. There’s also a constant ‘on’ mode. The 50 LEDs are dotted around the faux foliage to create a gentle ambience, helping guide you and your family home. Plus, this artificial wreath has the look of a wreath without the fuss of shedding needles.
